description: Affligem is a Belgian abbey beer, brewed in the tradition of the Affligem Abbey in Flanders and sold as Blond, Dubbel and Tripel.
Amstel is a Dutch beer brand from Amsterdam, best known for its pale lager and its alcohol-free variants.
Birra Moretti is an Italian beer brand founded in Udine, best known for its pale lager and its alcohol-free Zero.
Camrail supplies alloy steel bolts for rail and heavy equipment assembly, graded and offered in bulk pack sizes.
Coca-Cola is the world's best known cola soft drink, sold in classic, cherry, zero-sugar and a range of other variants.
Efes is a Turkish beer brand and the flagship pilsner of Anadolu Efes, widely distributed across Europe and Central Asia.
Epson is a Japanese manufacturer of printers, projectors and imaging equipment, known for its inkjet technology and business printing lines.
Erdinger is a Bavarian wheat beer brewery from the town of Erding, known for its Weissbier and its alcohol-free range.
Fabory is a European distributor of fasteners and industrial hardware, supplying bolts, nuts and fixings to maintenance, assembly and manufacturing customers.
Fanta is a fruit-flavoured carbonated soft drink brand, sold worldwide in orange and a wide range of regional flavours.
Grainger Approved is the private-label line of W. W. Grainger, the American industrial supply distributor, covering everyday maintenance and fastener items.
Grolsch is a Dutch brewery from Enschede, recognisable by its distinctive swing-top bottle and its premium lager.
Heineken is a Dutch brewer founded in Amsterdam, whose pale lager is one of the most widely distributed beers in the world.
HP is an American manufacturer of personal computers and printing hardware, with a printer range spanning home, workgroup and enterprise use.
Ken Forging supplies forged eyebolts and lifting hardware, offered in shouldered and plain patterns across imperial and metric sizes.
Prime-Line supplies general hardware and replacement parts, including fasteners for repair and assembly work.
Sprite is a clear lemon-lime flavoured soft drink, available in regular and no-sugar versions.
Una-Drive supplies steel and alloy steel drive bolts for freight car and heavy equipment assembly.
Xerox is an American document technology company, supplying office printers, multifunction devices and managed print services.
